messages:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert fired: PROD_GPU_POOL_HIGH_MEM_PRESSURE (PD-4321) -> repeated CUDA OOMs in gpu-pool-12. Severity: P1. Affected service: hosted-inference-east-1. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-4321
Maya Chen: acked. I'm starting a triage. tagging @Samir and @Lee.
PagerDuty: Acknowledged by Maya Chen. Escalation timer paused.
Samir Patel: I'm on pager. grabbing node/flamegraphs. initial glance: kvcache evictions spiked 00:12 UTC, pockets of persistent allocations.
Lee Carter: do we have customer-facing errors? any 5xx surge?
Ana Gutierrez: Observability shows 2.4% 500s and increased latency for a handful of customers in east-1. Correlated to pool 'gpu-pool-12'.
Maya Chen: good. can someone paste the OOM log lines?
Samir Patel: pasting tail from gpu-serve-12 logs:
```
2026-03-14T00:12:07Z gpu-serve-12 ERROR model_runner.cpp:124 CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: Tried to allocate 1.2GiB (total 11.8GiB)
2026-03-14T00:12:07Z gpu-serve-12 WARN kv_cache.cpp:87 excessive_kv_cache_allocations: kv_cache growth 3.8x
2026-03-14T00:12:08Z gpu-serve-12 ERROR runtime.cc:402 cudnn failed: CUDNN_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED
```
Samir Patel: NV driver version 525.60.11 on these hosts. evictions start right before OOMs.
Infra Oncall: paging infra metrics: GPU mem utilization climbed from 38% -> 96% over 90s across 6/12 nodes in pool.
Lee Carter: action plan?
Maya Chen: immediate mitigations: 1) drain new traffic from gpu-pool-12, 2) enable fallback routing to cpu-pool and other gpu pools, 3) reduce batch_size for affected model variants, 4) purge kvcache prefixes older than 1h to free KV slots.
Samir Patel: I'm executing drain: `rbacctl set pool gpu-pool-12 state=draining --reason "OOM spike"`
Samir Patel: started draining. traffic shifting -> expected 30s.
IncidentBot: Routing change: shifted 45% of traffic off gpu-pool-12 to gpu-pool-08, 20% to cpu-pool-01. Link: https://console.redwood/routing/charts/PD-4321
Ana Gutierrez: monitoring customer errors — 500s down to 0.6% after shift. latency still elevated for long-context requests.
Lee Carter: good. any persistent process-level leaks?
Samir Patel: found one model variant (gpt-xl-v2-quant) with runaway KV growth on sequence lengths > 8k. ramping quantized KV cache retention. patching hotfix to force KV cap per-request.
Maya Chen: deploy hotfix (canary) to pool-12 to stop future growth. keep pool drained until stable.
Samir Patel: canary deployed to 2 instances in pool-12: `deploy inference-hotfix:v2026.03.14-canary`
Samir Patel: logs show KV allocations stabilized on canary after 2 minutes.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty note: Escalation to SRE lead triggered if unacked in 10m — currently acknowledged.
Lee Carter: who will own customer comms? I can draft a short incident blurb for status page and CSMs.
Ana Gutierrez: please include mitigation steps and ETA for full recovery. ETA currently 30-45m to finish draining and verify no regressions.
Maya Chen: handoff: Samir you remain primary until next rotation (20:30 UTC). Lee you do comms. Ana monitor metrics. I'll follow up with post-incident runbook items.
Samir Patel: ack. I'll keep an eye on GPU utilization and OOM logs. If OOMs reappear after reintroducing traffic, we'll rollback recent driver/config changes and open an infra investigation.
Lee Carter: status page draft: "We detected GPU memory pressure impacting a subset of inference requests in east-1. Traffic was shifted and a hotfix deployed; error rates have returned to baseline. Investigation into cause ongoing; next update in 30 minutes." Any objections?
Ana Gutierrez: looks good. add note that no data was exposed and customers may have experienced increased latency/5xx.
Lee Carter: added. posting to status now.
Maya Chen: reintroducing traffic to pool-12 gradually at 75% of pre-incident rate to observe.
Samir Patel: reintroduction OK so far. no new OOMs for 12m. KV growth stable.
IncidentBot: Incident update posted to PD-4321. Reminder: create a postmortem and link to runbook items: kv-cache quotas, model max-seq checks, and autoscale policies.
Maya Chen: creating incident doc and assigning follow-ups: 1) add per-variant kv-cache soft-cap (owner: Samir), 2) add hazard test with long-context load (owner: Research), 3) review driver/firmware matrix for these GPUs (owner: Infra).
Samir Patel: will PR kv-cap change within 48h.
Lee Carter: closing on-call handoff: my shift takes over comms; Samir remains on-call for mitigation until rotation. Good work team. :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty: Incident resolved for now; incident status: MONITORED. If OOMs reoccur reopen PD-4321.
